notes.title: Patch 2.0.1.3 is live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just released a small patch, which mostly fixes a missing variable in the game. 


Patch notes 2.0.1.3

 Fixed a couple of typos thanks to a report by community member Seranth
 Fixed a missing variable preventing the game from taking into account a player choice in the Aeternus P02 finale


We hope you enjoy your time aboard Kappa station.

notes.title: Love Thyself - A Horatio Story Part 2 Out Now!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815009/c9fdb6b1ddecf9926d77add5925e2b1cb8f82db4.jpg

Just over two months ago, we released Love Thyself – A Horatio Story, the first ever visual novel set in the Endless Universe. Some people thought we were just indulging in an elaborate April Fool’s joke, but those who tried the game found a (mostly) serious story about finding your place in a society of clones. Many players have told us that they love this personal look at the Endless universe, and that they are eager for more.

The wait is finally over! Love Thyself – A Horatio Story Part 2, the exciting conclusion to this tale of clones, is out for free on Steam now! If you have already installed Love Thyself, Steam will automatically update the game with the Part 2 content. If you have not, this is a great time to check it out at the low price of absolutely free.


Part 2 Features:

Discover new locations across Kappa Station
Meet new characters, some of them not even Horatio
Four unique endings based on your actions and attitude
Get to know four uniquely identical Horatio, and perhaps more
New achievements, for those among you who pursue perfection




In addition to Part 2, we are releasing a bonus ending to our amazing Games2Gether community. Uncover the secrets of Kappa station and become the best Horatio you can be in the Super Secret Ending!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815009/ce8191cc6b4e7be9acd665000871f9c99d62c509.png

To unlock this bonus content, go to your rewards page, link your Steam Account, and click the “Redeem it on Steam” button in the description of the Love Thyself Super Secret Ending reward. This will add the Super Secret Ending DLC to your Steam library for you to enjoy.



Have fun,

The Amplitude Team

notes.title: Exploration Vessel Naming Contest - The Finals
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815009/ff1768186d4575931b2c219cae3b3d6a24991190.jpg

Now that the first phase of the ship naming contest is over, we are one step closer to finding the perfect name for the exploration vessel in Love Thyself Part 2. We have received many suggestions that I am sure Aeternus P02 would be quite pleased with. Thank you all for your submissions!

We have picked the top five appropriate submissions (with the small adjustment of merging Narcissus and Narcissa) to enter the finals. Now it’s time to determine the ship’s name and the winner of this contest!

The finalists are:


 Avant-Garde by Talross
 Illustrious Visage Eta by ImperatorTempus42
 Narcissus by Argonauty and Aranom (Both players will receive credit for this)
 Preciso Scalpellum by Hibbidy_Jibbidy
 His Glorious Light by Zephram


Cast your vote on Games2Gether!

notes.title: Love Thyself ship naming contest
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34815009/ff1768186d4575931b2c219cae3b3d6a24991190.jpg

Hey everyone,


As work on Part 2 of the fabulous Love Thyself – A Horatio Story continues, we find ourselves faced with a decision almost as difficult as picking the most beautiful Horatio.

At the end of part 1, you are given the option to accept a special mission far away from the watchful eyes of Aeternus P02, joining the crew of an exploration vessel.

Even the most humble vessel in His empire deserves a glorious name! While we could try to find a name on our own, you have shown us your devotion to the glory of Horatio when part 1 released, so who better to ask for advice than all of you?

We want your suggestions for a ship name fit for one of His explorers!

The Rules:
	Only one submission per user. Make it count.	Submissions cannot be upvoted until Tuesday, May 7th, and voting will end Tuesday, May 14th, after which we will pick the top 5 appropriate names to take into a final vote.	The name must not be copyrighted material.	No thread bumping	Keep your submission appropriate for Horatio and the tone of the game. No Boaty McBoatface, no copyright infringement (just saying that again), no memes.	For context and inspiration, here are some examples of names used by Horatio ship classes: Marchio, Baro, Archidux, Revealer, Beautifier, Exactor
 
The Reward:
	You get to name one of His vessels!	Your name in the credits.	An Amplitude T-shirt that will be the envy of your friends.
 
Reminder: Do not submit your ideas here! Create your own submission in the contest section of the Games2Gether so it can be upvoted!
